method.status: posthoc secondary analysis of a predeclared secondary endpoint
method.bootstrap: 1999 paired visitor-history resamples; RNG seed 1042026, matching the frozen environment-validation inference seed
method.comparison: same resampled visitor-history indices used for each intervention

interpretation: The opposite intervention effects are present in the absolute history-structured variance itself, not only in the reliability ratio. Capacity scaling increases reproducible between-history structure while lowering demographic residual variance; visitor-history pooling decreases between-history structure while leaving demographic residual variance similar.
claim_boundary: This paired variance comparison was computed after the prospective validation outcome was known and is therefore post-hoc secondary evidence.
History-structured variance was a predeclared secondary validation quantity, but its paired bootstrap difference was not a primary success criterion.
Do not interpret these model-conditional variance components as natural heritability, natural history prevalence, or field variance components.
